approval: Frank: Approved. Make sure this is NEVER forgotten.

identity.proportions: Natural adult lighthouse keeper; preserve the approved Prime mass, limb lengths, pivots and stance. Never substitute legacy, chibi or proxy anatomy.
identity.eyes: Solid dark rectangular eyes without whites or glints.
identity.moustache: Cream moustache visibly separate from the mouth.
identity.mouth: Short, straight, closed and readable; no generic grin.
identity.beard: Broad cream Prime beard mass with the approved facing-specific silhouette.
identity.uniform: Blue cap with navy band and gold badge; blue jumper with one continuous broad cream chest-and-sleeve band; navy trousers; blue-navy boots.
identity.rendering: Smooth antialiased Prime master rendering. Geometry and palette checks do not excuse a rough, pixelated or lower-density master.

front.role: Permanent identity, face, proportions, rendering and single-band standard-uniform authority

backView.role: Approved smooth rear view and rear-facing boot design authority

backRuntimeEndpoint.role: Latest approved same-facing standard-uniform rear animation endpoint and colour authority

standardUniformColourReferences.source: Exact approved same-family turn authority; medians are measurement references, not replacement flat swatches.

authoringRules.standardUniform: Match the exact approved facing authority and standard-uniform colour family; jumper and boots are hard-gated in every visible frame.
authoringRules.costumes: A costume may replace covered garment materials only. Prime anatomy, visible face, beard, hands, proportions, registration and facing identity remain binding.
ligneClaireCostumes: lines only at real edges; no hatching or texture strokes
closed areas with one flat colour; no gradients, shine or glow; at most one rare flat shadow tone
the material's own colour under even daylight
accurate construction simplified by omission, never cuteness
black only where the depicted material is black
all marks use the same line language
authoringRules.reversibility: Every new animation is a versioned draft. Every frame has a stable id and source hash so one frame can be replaced without rewriting its neighbours or any authority.
